description: resolve_user_id swallows sqlx errors and returns SINGLETON_USER_ID with a warn! log. The function signature is async fn resolve_user_id(...) -> i64 — callers cannot distinguish 'user found', 'user not found', and 'DB error'. In v1 single-user this is tolerable, but it sets a bad pattern: error handling silenced at the function boundary means jmap_api_handler can't return 503 when the DB is down. Should return Result<i64, sqlx::Error> and let the caller decide the fallback policy.
title: resolve_user_id silently falls back to SINGLETON_USER_ID on DB error with no caller signal
